description: Stacked Long Short-Term Memory network. Learns long-range temporal dependencies via learned gating mechanisms.

math.loss: MSE over 3 output targets at last timestep
math.intuition: f_t decides what to forget from cell memory; i_t * g_t writes new information. Gradient flows through c_t with minimal vanishing via the additive cell update — enabling memory over 0.5s+ horizons.

assumptions: Long-range temporal dependencies (>0.25s) contribute to drift prediction
Sequential order within a flight is meaningful
Stateless (windowed) mode: hidden states reset at each new window — no cross-window memory
Gap boundaries create invalid transitions — windows crossing gaps excluded

features_used.comment: All 34 GPS-denied-safe features. LSTM handles temporal context internally so rolling stats are included as additional signals.

architecture.comment: Hidden state from final LSTM timestep fed to linear head

training.windowing: sliding window, stride=10, label=last timestep of window
training.gap_handling: windows crossing gaps (any dt>0.1s within window) are excluded
